instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph, close-up shot at eye level against a plain white background. The dark-haired woman in a beige top (R2) on the left and the blonde woman in a white top (R1) on the right stand close together with their heads touching and eyes closed in a serene, intimate pose. Their arms cross in front of their chests as the blonde woman (R1) gently cradles the dark-haired woman's (R2) cheek with her hand, and the dark-haired woman (R2) cradles the blonde woman's (R1) cheek with her hand. Soft, even studio lighting illuminates their faces, creating a gentle, minimalist aesthetic with clean, neutral tones.
